critiques.claim: Requirements priority can be calculated using a single scalar formula like Priority = Cost / (Value * (1 - Risk)).
critiques.critique: A single score collapses incompatible dimensions. Legal obligations, critical safety controls, and optional user features should not compete in one weighted formula. Story points are team-local relative estimation constructs, not standardized cross-team measurements.
critiques.nuance: Scalar formulas are helpful for ranking backlog items within a single feature category or single team backlog.
